steps.en: Get macOS 15 booting through OpenCore on the PC first, with the NVIDIA card installed
steps.zh: 先让这台装着 N 卡的 PC 经 OpenCore 跑起 macOS 15

steps.en: Add the driver's boot-args, SIP value and BAR quirks to OpenCore config.plist
steps.zh: 在 config.plist 里加启动参数、SIP 值和 BAR 设置

steps.en: Unpack the release package, check its hashes, run the installer as root
steps.zh: 解开发布包，校验哈希，用 root 跑安装脚本

steps.en: Copies four kexts and the Metal bundles into place, rebuilds the Auxiliary Kernel Collection
steps.zh: 把四个内核扩展和 Metal 驱动包放到位，重建辅助内核集合

steps.en: Reboot; approve the extensions in Privacy & Security when asked, then reboot again
steps.zh: 重启；按提示在“隐私与安全性”里允许扩展，再重启一次

steps.en: At boot, NVRM loads NVIDIA's GSP firmware and brings the GPU up; NVRMFB lights the displays
steps.zh: 开机时 NVRM 载入 GSP 固件拉起 GPU，NVRMFB 点亮屏幕

steps.en: Metal calls go through the plugin: shaders are translated to SPIR-V and run by NVK on the card
steps.zh: Metal 调用走插件：着色器转成 SPIR-V，由 NVK 在显卡上执行

value.en: The desktop and Metal apps run on a GeForce RTX card that macOS has had no driver for since High Sierra
value.zh: 桌面和 Metal 应用跑在一张 macOS 自 High Sierra 之后就没有驱动的 GeForce RTX 卡上

sources: README.md 'Install — prebuilt (recommended)' (tar -xzf, shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS, sudo ./install.sh, sudo shutdown -r now; allow the extensions in Privacy & Security)
README.md 'Wiring into an existing OpenCore setup' (boot-args value, csr-active-config <430A0000>, ResizeGpuBars 13, ResizeAppleGpuBars -1, IONDRVSupport Exclude, SecureBootModel Disabled)
docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md sections 1-3 (NVRM loads GSP firmware from /Users/Shared/nvfw and boots the GPU; NVRMFB is the IOFramebuffer; NVMTLDriver.bundle -> translator AIR to SPIR-V -> NVK)
package/install.sh (copies NVMTLDriver.bundle, NVIDIAShared.bundle, nvmtl and firmware; rebuilds the kernel collection)
